No TurboQuant was successfully dispatched this session.

llama.cpp auto-fit (-fit on, the default) hangs at 99% CPU for 2+ minutes on large GGUF models; always pass -fit off explicitly
On UMA APUs, model buffers land in GTT (shared system RAM) not VRAM — rocm-smi VRAM Used stays flat while GTT Used grows; this is normal and expected
Kernel version claims in planning docs should be verified against kernel.ubuntu.com before installing — v6.18.4 had a failed build (no .deb); v6.18.23 is the actual latest 6.18 longterm build
